source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. The header prints only 'SCHOOL' (no school name). No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name (...-150323-2023) and the icseboard.org folder. Marks are printed only per group. Groups whose printed marks do not divide into whole marks per item (I: 6 items [3]; II: 6 items [3]; IV: 4 items [2]; VIII: 4 items [2]) are kept as one entry per group; groups whose marks divide evenly (III, V, VI, IX, X) are split into one entry per item with marks from the group total. Question X is 'any four' of five (8 marks), so the items are 2 marks each and the listed total exceeds the attempted total. Question XI 'Practical [15]' is printed with no question text in the file, so it is not included; the listed questions total 35 of 50 before counting X's choice (37 as listed). Handwritten ticks/crosses on the scan are ignored. The icseboard.org watermark is ignored.
